provider_enforced_usage_blocks.notes: Minimum permitted 1-cent provider overage threshold. Metering is asynchronous and does not cover D1/Queues/KV/R2.

warnings: Provider 1-cent usage blocks cannot promise zero excess charges.
D1, Queues, KV, R2, storage, taxes and independent provider bills are not controlled by Workers/DO spend blocks.
Soft quotas can be bypassed by independent Workers, cron, GitHub Actions, third-party clients and delayed provider counters unless individually integrated.
A strict never-exceed-$5 invoice cannot be guaranteed with a metered Workers Paid account.

Owner daily TOTAL D1 target: <=140k billed rows read and <=140k billed rows written, including all recovery work. There is no automatic or manual 40k D1 write extension; provider counters are delayed and non-atomic, so a global hard stop is not yet guaranteed.
Emergency reads and writes each reserve 20k inside the existing 140k UTC TOTAL. Normal automated workloads must fit in 120k read and 120k write; recovery has no automatic access, no 40k extension.
A KV get/put quota counter is not atomic; quota control uses provider-observed rows and UTC burn-rate pacing for admission-gated work, not a provider-enforced account-wide 140k hard stop.

d1_budget_policy.remarks: Ordinary admission is capped to 120k physical rows read/written per UTC day; 20k emergency per lane is separately reserved inside 140k total, never automatically used. Cloudflare counters are delayed/non-atomic and independent writers need the same admission policy.
